messages:
Alex: Heads up — planning a small EU edge traffic nudge tonight 22:00 UTC to shift 5% -> 20% over 30m for canary. Keeping TTL 60s. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?
Priya: I can drive the deployment. ETA 21:45 UTC to prep. Will monitor.
Miguel: Will be on-call for infra, I'll watch LB metrics and BGP flaps.
Sam: I'll run smoke scripts and verify tokenized latency probes. Share runbook link?
Alex: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-edge-nudge-v2 — follow the 'incremental' section. Steps 1-6.
Priya: Plan: 22:00 start, 5% step every 6m -> 5,10,15,20. Smoke after each step. Rollback on error is to revert policy to 0% and switch TTL back to 30s.
Katie: Reminder: Warm KV cache step before first increase: run `curl -X POST https://edge-prep.internal/api/warm-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` (I pasted command in pinned msg)
Sam: Smoke checklist (will paste results inline):
- probe-latency < 200ms
- error-rate < 0.5%
- 95p token time < 400ms
Miguel: Infra checks:
- route convergence within 30s
- no AS path changes
Priya: tagging who: @alex @miguel @sam @katie — will post updates per step.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Priya at 2024-06-12T22:00:00Z. Track run id r-4382
Alex: If we see >1% error spike or latency > 2x baseline, rollback immediately. Also watch per-region 5xxs.
Priya: Starting now — prepping caches.
Sam: Smoke 0 (baseline): latency 120ms, errors 0.1%, 95p token 280ms :thumbsup:
Priya: Step 1 -> 5% applied at 22:00:36 UTC.
Sam: Smoke 1: latency 130ms, errors 0.2%, 95p 300ms. OK.
Priya: Step 2 -> 10% at 22:06:40 UTC.
Sam: Smoke 2: latency 140ms errors 0.6% — spike, investigating.
Miguel: Seeing small BGP updates around eu-west-1 associated with new peers, watching.
Priya: Hold on step 3. Investigating spike.
Alex: If errors stay >0.5% for 2 consecutive minutes, rollback.
Sam: errors back down to 0.15% after 30s. 95p 310ms. Looks stable.
Priya: Proceeding to step 3 -> 15% at 22:16:41 UTC.
Sam: Smoke 3: latency 150ms errors 0.2% fine.
Priya: Final -> 20% at 22:22:46 UTC.
Sam: Final smoke: latency 160ms errors 0.12% 95p 330ms. All green.
Miguel: No further infra anomalies.
Priya: Done. Will keep the TTL at 60s for 2 hours then raise to 300s if stable.
Alex: Nice — add postmortem notes and cost delta estimate.
Priya: Will add notes to runbook and closing this thread. Thanks all. :tada:
